meta.name: digital-avatar-shopping-video
meta.description: 电商运营与自媒体创作者在需要制作商品推荐或促销带货短视频时，使用此技能可一键生成“小省导购员”数字人口播视频。系统自动协同五大智能体完成脚本、画面与音画合成，产出适配抖音、快手等平台的成品，高效搞定带货视频制作。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入商品信息，自动产出数字人带货短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你做电商或自媒体，需要快速生成商品推荐视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into ready-to-post avatar shopping videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create product promo videos regularly for e-commerce or social media

howto.what: Claude 会按“小省导购员”人设，协同脚本、口播、画面、合成等智能体，产出一支 9:16 竖屏 MP4 数字人口播带货视频，含口播脚本、音频、动态画面和字幕。
howto.when: 当你要做带货视频、产品推荐或价格对比视频，或购物咨询类视频时触发；同类商品需求会先查知识库调取已有素材。

say.text: 帮我做一条性价比手机推荐的口播带货视频，时长60秒
say.note: 会依次生成脚本、口播、画面并合成MP4

say.text: 比较京东和淘宝的Nike男鞋价格，做成对比视频
say.note: 输出分屏价格对比口播视频

say.text: 618大促推荐三款爆款家电，做90秒竖屏视频
say.note: 按促销场景生成脚本与画面

howto.what_en: Claude acts as the 'Xiaosheng shopping guide', coordinating five agents (guide, script, voice-over, visuals, compositor) to produce a 9:16 MP4 avatar-narrated product video with script, audio, motion visuals and subtitles.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a product-promotion, product-recommendation or price-comparison/shopping-consultation video; similar product requests first check the knowledge base for existing assets.

say_en.text: Make a 60-second avatar talking-head video recommending value-for-money phones
say_en.note: Runs script, voice-over, visuals, then MP4 compositing

say_en.text: Compare Nike men's shoe prices on JD and Taobao as a video
say_en.note: Outputs a split-screen price comparison video

say_en.text: Recommend three hot home appliances for 618 in a 90-second vertical video
